verdict.rationale: The pack contains no documentation or hands-on report of Ollama splitting a model's layers across GPU VRAM and system RAM so that models larger than available VRAM can run. The nearest items are about something else: running larger models on Ollama's Cloud is remote hosting, not local CPU+GPU offload, and a community log of a full fallback to CPU when ROCm is missing is not combined offload. Neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can run models larger than my available VRAM using combined CPU+GPU offload
